paper_title: The Safety Reminder A Soft Prompt to Reactivate Delayed Safety   Awareness in Vision-Language Models
caption: The proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" for four different model and dataset combinations across four discrete points on the x-axis. The x-axis is unlabelled and presents discrete numerical values at 128, 256, 512, and 1024, arranged with equal visual spacing despite the non-linear numerical intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick marks regularly spaced at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains four solid lines. The blue line with circular markers represents "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep," which begins at approximately 0.20 at an x-value of 128, rises to 0.25 at 256, increases to 0.35 at 512, and ends with a slight increase to roughly 0.36 at 1024. The orange line with square markers denotes "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep," starting at 0.15 at 128, rising to 0.23 at 256, climbing to 0.42 at 512, and maintaining a steady, flat trend to finish at 0.42 at 1024. The green line with upward-pointing triangular markers represents "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench"; it originates at approximately 0.06 at 128, sharply increases to 0.21 at 256, rises to 0.37 at 512, and ends at roughly 0.38 at 1024. Finally, the red line with diamond markers corresponds to "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench," beginning at 0.24 at 128, slightly increasing to 0.26 at 256, climbing to roughly 0.42 at 512, and reaching its highest point at approximately 0.51 at the final x-axis value of 1024.
